result: Won all four races of the weekend, clinching the Junior title with a last-lap pass over Knox Black (AUS)
whyItMattered: Han didn't just dominate on pace — the title-deciding final saw him and Knox Black trade the lead repeatedly across all 17 laps before Han sealed it with a decisive overtake on the final lap. The win also qualifies him for the Arrive and Drive World Cup in Malaysia this November.
stat: 4-for-4 race wins; title clinched on a last-lap pass after a 17-lap lead battle
